registration.divisionRulesContent:
Article 54 (Division Autonomy Rules)
1. Division autonomy rules are rules that each division may establish, amend, or abolish to operate its student council.
2. These rules may not conflict with the Union constitution. Any conflicting provisions are invalid to the extent of the conflict.
3. Division autonomy rules may be established or amended by a resolution at a division meeting.
4. Adopted rules must be announced within three days and take effect five days after adoption.
5. When rules are established, amended, or abolished, the division student council chair must promptly report the changes at the next Operating Committee meeting.
6. No later than 20 days before the start of each regular semester, the division student council chair must inform the Executive of whether division autonomy rules exist and submit the latest version.
